data.name: Home.Description
data.value: Manage multiple Citus databases with capability-first checks and durable checkpoints.

data.name: Home.ClusterDescription
data.value: Each profile represents one Citus-enabled PostgreSQL database.

data.name: Home.EmptyDescription
data.value: Register a coordinator. A read-only capability scan runs before the profile is saved.

data.name: Cluster.PlanHelp
data.value: After confirmation, the plan queues immediately; the runner rechecks capability and state.

data.name: Cluster.OperationsHelp
data.value: Refreshes every five seconds when HTMX is available.

data.name: Cluster.DeleteHelp
data.value: Deletes this profile and all associated control-plane history. The target Citus cluster and external backup objects are not changed.

data.name: Create.Description
data.value: Test the Citus endpoint, then register the profile. This does not create infrastructure or change the cluster.

data.name: Create.EndpointHelp
data.value: Use a metadata read-only account when only monitoring is required. Credentials are encrypted before storage.

data.name: Create.DatabaseHelp
data.value: Citus metadata is scoped to each database.

data.name: Create.PasswordHelp
data.value: Never logged or returned by the API.

data.name: Create.ScanHelp
data.value: PostgreSQL/Citus version, current database/user, function signatures, metadata views, nodes, distributed tables, and shards.

data.name: Controller.RegisterDetail
data.value: Check host, database, TLS, account, metadata permissions, and the Citus extension.

data.name: Controller.ConnectDetail
data.value: Check host, port, database, TLS, account, metadata permissions, and the Citus extension.

data.name: Controller.InventoryError
data.value: Could not collect inventory. Check network, TLS, authentication, and coordinator state.

data.name: Controller.Deleted
data.value: Local profile and associated history deleted. The Citus cluster was not changed.

data.name: Cluster.RemoveConfirmation
data.value: Remove must exactly match the worker host.

data.name: Cluster.CapacityAck
data.value: I confirm backup/PITR was tested, disk/WAL/network/connections are sufficient, and a rollback owner is assigned.

data.name: Cluster.WarningHelp
data.value: Rebalance and drain move data; they are not backups. Remove is available only when the target has exactly zero placements.

data.name: Cluster.AddQueryNodeHelp
data.value: Register a provisioned Citus MX query node. It serves queries and connections but never stores distributed shards.

data.name: Cluster.AddWorkerHelp
data.value: Register an already provisioned PostgreSQL/Citus node as a shard-eligible worker.

data.name: Cluster.DrainWarning
data.value: The worker stays registered after its placements reach zero. Use this before maintenance.

data.name: Cluster.DrainWorkerShort
data.value: Move data away; keep node registered

data.name: Cluster.NotAnotherCoordinator
data.value: This is not another control coordinator.

data.name: Cluster.OperationsHelpNew
data.value: Recent durable topology changes. Active progress is read from the control database.

data.name: Cluster.QueryNodeAck
data.value: I confirm this PostgreSQL/Citus node is provisioned, reachable, version-compatible, and must not hold shards.

data.name: Cluster.QueryNodeExplanation
data.value: CitusManager syncs metadata and may route read-only work here. DDL, topology, backup, and admin work remain pinned to the control coordinator.

data.name: Cluster.QueryNodesHelp
data.value: Metadata-synced endpoints that spread read-only query and connection load.

data.name: Cluster.RebalanceAfterAddHelp
data.value: Create a fresh plan after the worker is active and move shards toward it.

data.name: Cluster.RebalanceHelp
data.value: Redistribute placements across eligible workers. Preview is a snapshot and is revalidated before execution.

data.name: Cluster.RetireHelp
data.value: Drain all placements, verify zero remain, then remove Citus metadata for

data.name: Cluster.RetireSequence
data.value: Data moves before metadata is removed.

data.name: Cluster.RetireWarning
data.value: This does not delete or stop the VM/container. If drain fails, the node is not removed.

data.name: Cluster.TablesHelp
data.value: Distributed table inventory from the cached topology snapshot.

data.name: Cluster.TypeHostToConfirm
data.value: Type the worker host to confirm:

data.name: Cluster.WorkersHelp
data.value: Shard-eligible nodes that store distributed data.

data.name: Cluster.ConfirmationMismatch
data.value: Confirmation must exactly match the worker host.

data.name: Cluster.MissingOperationId
data.value: Operation queued, but the response did not include its identifier.

data.name: Cluster.RemoveQueryNodeShort
data.value: Disable routing and remove Citus metadata

data.name: Cluster.RemoveNodeHelp
data.value: Drain distributed placements when present, verify zero remain, then remove Citus metadata for

data.name: Cluster.TypeNodeHostToConfirm
data.value: Type the node host to confirm:

data.name: Cluster.ChangeCoordinator
data.value: Move coordinator to a new server

data.name: Cluster.ChangeCoordinatorHelp
data.value: Create a reviewed plan for moving the authoritative control coordinator to another PostgreSQL/Citus server.

data.name: Cluster.ChangeCoordinatorPlanOnly
data.value: This step does not change the cluster. The operation will wait for external fencing, standby promotion, and explicit approval.

data.name: Cluster.ChangeCoordinatorRisk
data.value: CitusManager does not promote PostgreSQL, change DNS/load balancers, stop the old server, or fence receiving endpoints. A failed or incomplete external failover can cause split brain or data loss.

data.name: Cluster.ChangeCoordinatorSameCredentials
data.value: Preflight uses this cluster profile's database, username, stored password, and TLS mode against the target.

data.name: Cluster.TypeTargetEndpointToConfirm
data.value: Type the exact target endpoint to confirm the plan:

data.name: Cluster.TargetEndpointConfirmationMismatch
data.value: Confirmation must exactly match the target host:port.

data.name: Cluster.CoordinatorPlanAck
data.value: I confirm backup/PITR and rollback access were tested, the physical standby is ready for external promotion, and an owner is assigned for fencing every receiving endpoint.

data.name: Cluster.CoordinatorRecoveryHelp
data.value: Confirm manual data reconciliation here. CitusManager will validate cluster health, resolve the restore gate, and retry this migration plan automatically.

data.name: Cluster.CoordinatorRecoveryAutoCancel
data.value: Awaiting-approval plans that never started will be cancelled automatically. Running or dispatched work is never stopped automatically.

data.name: Cluster.CoordinatorRecoveryAck
data.value: I confirm manual recovery and application-level data validation are complete.

data.name: Cluster.CoordinatorRecoveryConfirmationMismatch
data.value: Confirmation must exactly match the restore ID.
